news.title: Gartner: Global IT Spending Surge to Hit $6.37 Trillion in 2026
news.summary: Gartner forecasts global IT spending to reach $6.37 trillion in 2026, marking a 14.2% increase from 2025. This surge is primarily driven by massive investments in AI infrastructure, cloud platforms, and intelligent applications, with data center systems and Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) identified as the leading growth segments. Despite this overall growth, Gartner notes that technology budgets face pressures from inflation, supply shortages, and rising hardware costs, leading to a market trend where growth is concentrated in AI-related areas rather than across all segments.

news.title: Synopsys Advances Agentic AI Chip Design with AMD and Microsoft
news.summary: Synopsys has announced new autonomous agentic AI workflows for chip design, developed in collaboration with Microsoft and available for evaluation on Microsoft Discovery. These workflows, which are also being utilized by AMD, aim to accelerate engineering from specification to silicon. Key innovations include fully-autonomous debug closure and implementation/closure workflows, demonstrating significant reductions in cycle time and improved quality of results.

news.title: Capital One’s MLB partnership is turning fan experiences into long-term customer value
news.summary: Capital One's MLB partnership leverages exclusive experiences and cardholder perks to attract and retain customers, exemplified by the successful All-Star Village event that drew over 111,000 attendees. This sponsorship is a long-duration customer acquisition strategy for Capital One, tying card perks directly to MLB and mapping fan journeys to customer lifetime value. The initiative comes as Capital One integrates Discover Financial Services and reports strong financial results, underscoring its capital deployment for long-term growth.

news.title: Why Is Alphabet (GOOGL) Still Falling After a Record Q2 Beat?
news.summary: Alphabet's shares have fallen despite a strong Q2 earnings report primarily due to a massive $44.9 billion quarterly capital expenditure and the realization that reported EPS included significant unrealized investment gains, rather than operational income. Concerns about long-term free cash flow and credit quality, highlighted by Moody's, have overshadowed robust revenue growth and a new $1 billion Verizon deal. Despite the sell-off, analysts maintain a strong buy rating with a consensus price target of $417.70, viewing the current valuation as attractive given the company's growth and cloud margin recovery.

news.title: Uber-Backed EV Firm Says Iran War Is Accelerating Electric Vehicle Adoption in South Africa
news.summary: Valternative, an Uber-backed EV fleet manager in South Africa, states that the ongoing Iran war is accelerating EV adoption in the region due to high fuel costs. While infrastructure remains a challenge, the company plans to expand charging stations and its fleet, aiming to replace traditional fossil-fueled vehicles. This development comes as Uber simultaneously expands its food delivery services and faces potential changes in its partnership with Waymo.

news.title: MercadoLibre Stock: Why This E-Commerce Leader Can Outperform the Market Over the Next 5 Years
news.summary: MercadoLibre stock has dropped 31% from its peak due to concerns over margin pressure and competition, yet its business growth remains strong in Latin America's e-commerce market. The company is investing heavily in its logistics and fintech operations, which are driving faster delivery, lower costs, and increased customer engagement. Despite current margin dips due to infrastructure spending, this e-commerce and fintech leader is projected to double in value within five years due to significant growth potential in underpenetrated markets.

news.title: European Fund Returns to Nio with $19M Stake in First Major Q2 2026 Filing
news.summary: Assenagon Asset Management, a European fund managing approximately €83 billion, has re-established a significant position in Nio, acquiring 3,756,576 American depositary shares valued at over $19 million as of June 30, 2026. This move marks Assenagon's largest investment in Nio to date, 55 times greater than its previous peak holding, following a complete exit in late 2024. The filing provides the first insight into institutional investment activity in Nio for Q2 2026, with more updates expected from other major holders in the coming weeks.

news.title: Last day to claim some of Amazon's $2.5B settlement money
news.summary: Today, July 27, 2026, is the last day for Texans to file a claim in a $2.5 billion settlement against Amazon. The lawsuit alleges that Amazon used deceptive practices, known as "dark patterns," to trick customers into unwanted Prime memberships. Eligible consumers can claim up to $51 in membership fee refunds, with payments expected by September 2026 via PayPal, Venmo, or mailed check.
